0022600112.text: The Lakers (2-0, 1st in the Pacific and 1st in the West) play their third game of the 2026-27 season on the road against the Utah Jazz (1-1, 4th in the Northwest, 1 game back, 8th in the West), who have also played two games so far. Los Angeles has Adou Thiero, Cameron Carr and Jake LaRavia listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions, while Utah is without Jusuf Nurkic, who is out with a foot strain, and Trey Alexander, who is day-to-day with a knee bruise and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Lakers won the 2025-26 season series 4-0 and beat Utah 131-107 in Los Angeles on April 12, 2026.
